chunks.label: On my way
chunks.rationale: Lets you ask where someone is and report your progress when meeting up.
chunks.interference: Tsuita yo (I'm here) and mou sugu tsuku (almost there) differ only in tense.

chunks.label: Late and waiting
chunks.rationale: Lets you apologize for being late and handle the moment you meet up.
chunks.interference: Okurete gomen (I was late) versus chotto okureru (I will be late).

chunks.label: Are you okay
chunks.rationale: Lets you check on someone who is hurt, upset or getting better.
chunks.interference: Daijoubu desu as an answer can mean no thanks, not just I'm fine.

chunks.label: Don't worry
chunks.rationale: Lets you reassure someone who apologizes, worries or rushes.
chunks.interference: Ki ni shinaide (don't mind it) and shinpai shinaide (don't be anxious) are not interchangeable.

chunks.label: Waiting your turn
chunks.rationale: Lets you follow staff when you're asked to wait, called forward or served.
chunks.interference: Omatase shimashita (sorry for the wait) and omachi kudasai (please wait) share a verb but come at opposite moments.
members: こちらのレジへどうぞ

chunks.label: Getting a table
chunks.rationale: Lets you get from the restaurant door to your seat.
chunks.interference: Omachi shite orimashita (we expected you) sounds like omachi kudasai (please wait).
members: ご予約はされていますか
お待ちしておりました

chunks.label: Ordering a meal
chunks.rationale: Lets you follow the waiter from ordering to clearing the plates.
chunks.interference: Gochuumon wa okimari (ready to order?) and gochuumon wa ijou (is that all?) start the same way.
members: ご注文はお決まりですか
ご注文は以上でよろしいですか
お飲み物はいかがなさいますか
お下げしてもよろしいですか

chunks.label: For here or to go
chunks.rationale: Lets you answer the quick questions at fast-food and convenience-store counters.
chunks.interference: Tennai (eat in) and mochikaeri (take home) both expect a plain hai, so listen for which one was asked.
members: 店内でお召し上がりですか
お箸はお付けしますか

chunks.label: Checkout questions
chunks.rationale: Lets you get through the questions at almost any shop register.
chunks.interference: Daijoubu desu here means no thanks, not yes.
members: ポイントカードはお持ちですか
お支払いはどうされますか

chunks.label: Making plans
chunks.rationale: Lets you settle a day, time and place with a friend, and back out if you must.
chunks.interference: Itsu (when, which day) versus nanji (what time).

chunks.label: Get well soon
chunks.rationale: Lets you say the right thing to someone sick, tired or leaving for a while.
chunks.interference: Odaiji ni is only for illness; karada ni ki o tsukete is the general take care.

chunks.label: Cheering someone up
chunks.rationale: Lets you comfort someone who's down and praise their effort.
chunks.interference: Faito means keep going, not fight; ganbatte is the everyday cheer.

chunks.label: Calming someone down
chunks.rationale: Lets you soothe someone who is panicking or crying, and react to sad news.

chunks.label: Keeping in touch
chunks.rationale: Lets you start, keep up and wind down contact with friends.
chunks.interference: Mata renraku suru ne can be a polite brush-off rather than a promise.

chunks.label: Starting a call
chunks.rationale: Lets you open a call and cope with a bad line, a low battery or an unknown caller.

chunks.label: Handing over money
chunks.rationale: Lets you follow the cashier as you pay and get your change.
chunks.interference: Oazukari shimasu names the money you handed over, not the total you owe.
members: ご一緒でよろしいですか
一括でよろしいですか

chunks.label: Shop greetings
chunks.rationale: Lets you understand staff as you browse, ask for help and leave.
chunks.interference: Nanika osagashi desu ka (looking for something?) versus nanika goyou desu ka (what do you need?).

chunks.label: Calling back
chunks.rationale: Lets you put off a call and follow up on one you missed.
chunks.interference: Denwa suru (call) versus kakenaosu and orikaesu (call back).
members: 折り返しお電話します
電話出られなくてごめん

chunks.label: Clinic and front desk
chunks.rationale: Lets you follow reception at a clinic, office or business phone line.
chunks.interference: Ukagau means ask here, but come or visit in tadaima ukagaimasu.
members: 今日はどうされましたか
お電話ありがとうございます
保険証をお願いします
お名前を伺ってもよろしいですか

drops.reason: Duplicate of ごゆっくりどうぞ; the short form is mentioned in that entry's notes.
Duplicate of 何かあった？ with the softening no; mentioned in that entry's notes.
Duplicate of なんとかなるよ, the same phrase without yo.
